description:
Reference implementation (Python package poslayers) of the decomposition of positional expression signals into a tissue mean profile, GC-associated variation, copy-number dosage and residual local covariance, with the analysis scripts that produce every result, table and figure of the article Common cis-regulatory inputs shape local gene co-expression across human tissues, and an interactive simulator.

All inputs are public and are not redistributed; data/MANIFEST.md lists each one and its source. The tables needed to rebuild every figure without the raw data are deposited separately as source data.
notes: Release accompanying the submitted manuscript (5 figures, 5 Extended Data figures, Supplementary Tables 1-9). Add the article DOI as a related identifier (relation: isSupplementTo) on publication.
